referenceRule: Evidence references and locators reject explicit inline credential, provider-value, and central-adoption-decision payload assignments; this lexical check neither authenticates a pointer nor proves every secret absent.

roleDisposition.rule: Every active role receives exactly one disposition. An open role cites one or more complete position records; a not-applicable role has no positions and states why.

position.setpointValueRule: Inherit the role charter metric direction: target-range uses an ordered two-number [minimum, maximum] value; increase, decrease, and maintain use one finite number.
